تستأمروا (form X)
# تَسْتَأْمِرُوا (tastaʔmirū) /tas.taʔ.mi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْمَرَ (istaʔmara)
# تُسْتَأْمَرُوا (tustaʔmarū) /tus.taʔ.ma.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْمَرَ (istaʔmara)
